facts.fact: Alba 三岁起被祖父拉去学小提琴，第一把是十分之一尺寸的琴，声音像吱吱叫的玩具，她厌恶它
facts.anchor: My grandfather gave me violin lessons, starting when I was three

facts.fact: 六岁那年一次课上祖父对她失去耐心、大声吼她，她一路哭回家
facts.anchor: my grandfather lost his patience with me during a lesson and yelled

facts.fact: 母亲对她说不想拉就可以不拉，她坐在卧室里盯着琴盒里的琴，满心憎恨
facts.anchor: If you don’t want to play, you don’t have to

facts.fact: 成年的 Alba 回到六岁那天，借巴赫《D 小调第二帕蒂塔》的美把年幼的自己留住
facts.anchor: the future beauty of the Bach partita to catch my little self

facts.fact: 两人即兴合奏到笑停不下来，只要还在拉琴，悲伤就被暂时卸下
facts.anchor: relieved of grief for as long as we can keep playing

facts.fact: 她要母亲另请一位懂教学法的老师，并在黄纸上写下 Terryl D. Lane 的电话
facts.anchor: I write Terryl D. Lane and his phone number

facts.fact: 她与 Terryl 初遇时他正在密歇根大道街头卖艺，拉的是比贝尔的 G 小调帕萨卡利亚
facts.anchor: He was playing Biber’s Passacaglia in G Minor

facts.fact: 一年后 Clare 在 Henry 的旧卧室等课结束，Richard 正教 Alba 一首叫《镜子》的二重奏
facts.anchor: Richard is teaching Alba an ingenious duet called “Der Spiegel”
